notes: Enumerated every pool from the ERC20PoolFactory on all 5 reachable chains (base/arbitrum/optimism/polygon/gnosis) and ran one isolated probe per pool. ZERO payers. Two pools hold real claimable reserves (5539668248122795 and 1286215412485120990 of quote token) and kickReserveAuction() is callable there, but it settles nothing to the caller in the same call — the kicker award is not an immediate transfer.

Reverts for a caller holding no debt asset — the liquidator must transfer debtToCover IN before receiving collateral. Fails rule (a): non-zero principal. mintToTreasury([USDC]) is callable by anyone and pays the caller 0.

absorb() reverts (no underwater account at this block) and pays the absorber in non-transferable liquidator points, never a token. accrueAccount() is callable by anyone and pays 0. No caller bounty exists in Comet.
Fully permissionless and callable by an arbitrary caller (measured, does not revert) but pays the caller nothing in WETH or AERO. Aerodrome/Velodrome gauge distribution carries no keeper bounty.
